حَوْبَآءُ The soul; syn. نَفْسٌ; (AZ, S, K;) as also ↓ حُوبٌ : (AZ, K:) or the soul whose seat is in the heart; syn. رُوحُ القَلْبِ [also called the animal soul, رُوح حَيَوَانِىّ: see art. روح]: AHei asserts, in a disquisition on the heart, that this word is formed by transcription form حَبْوَآءُ: (TA:) pl. حَوْبَاوَاتٌ. (S, K.) You say, حَرَسَ ٱللّٰهُ حَوْبَآءَكَ [May God guard, or preserve, thy soul]. (A.) ―
-b2- [Also] The body, or person; in Persian تَنْ. (KL.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
